independence_evidence: Contact page: 'As a Behind the Blinds Arts project, SHADOWPLAY is a bi annual publication... Curated by the same team of BTB' (https://www.shadowplaymagazine.com/contact); Behind the Blinds is a small independent Brussels fashion/art magazine studio, not a media group.
qualifies_reason: Independent Belgian art and beauty publication whose print Issue 10 shipped from mid-September 2026.
what_it_is: A thick art and beauty publication from the makers of Behind the Blinds, built from photographic portfolios, interviews and essays that treat beauty as a subject across fashion, art, music and film. Each issue is released with a dozen or more alternate covers featuring artists, musicians and models (Issue 10 includes Anton Corbijn, Mylène Farmer and Nairy Baghramian). It is for collectors of photography-led fashion and art magazines.

uncertainties: Neither shadowplaymagazine.com nor behindtheblinds.be prints a postal address; Brussels rests on the Behind the Blinds site's Brussels time zone and an interview with founder Michael Marson describing his Brussels base (wbdm.be). Price: the Shadowplay store lists each Issue 10 cover at 20 EUR while the BTB shop lists them at 25 EUR; the title's own store price is recorded. Issue 10 went on pre-order 11 August 2026 with delivery from mid-September 2026; the KD Presse hint also says 2026-09. Publisher says bi-annual, but Issue 9 was a 2025 edition and Issue 10 came in 2026, so the recent cadence is annual.
